tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The concerned ageny should submit the EPF & ESI Details of all the engaged manpower along with Aadhar number wthin the stipulated period during submission of monthly bills compulsorily, Otherwise the bill will not be considered.
Contractor has to quote for Total amount in lumpsum for BASIC plus VDA plus SERVICE CHARGES.not to quote lumpsum amount in 1 percent or 2 percent etc if so the tender will be rejected
The lumpsum amount quoted by the bidder shall not be less than the total amount of BASIC PLUS VDA if it is less the tender will be rejected

EPF Clearance Certificate for having remitted the EPF shall be obtained from not below the rank of Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner for the last financial year 2025-26 to be uploaded & submit hard copy at the time of Agreement
ESI Clearance Certificate for having remitted the ESI shall be obtained from the competent authority for the last financial year 2025-2026 to be uploaded & submit hard copy at the time of Agreement
The agency has to pay the variable DA to the labours as per the prevailing Govt Orders the same shall be considered in the RA Bills.
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site availability of Man power for supply of manpower before submission of their tenders
The rate considered in bill of quantities are inclusive of EPF, ESI, GST will be paid wherever it is applicable
The agency has to remit the employers part and labour part of ESI & EPF amount by opening account in each individuals name or to the already existing account
The Agency has to engage the manpower for the work in between 18 years to 60 years age and as per the prevailing labour department norms
The agency has to provide required Tools and Equipments to manpower engaged in water management of canals and cleaning essentials engaged in housekeeping ,dam & Colony maintenance at his own cost
The agency has to provide different type uniform based on their work to all the manpower engaged at his own cost

Manpower labours/staff supplied by the man power agency are the workers of the manpower agency not workers KNNL/WRD. The services of the manpower are temporary and they are not eligible for the departmental benefits

The manpower supplying agency is responsible for the proper water management of canals, maintenance of dams and offices etc. The labours supplied shall do the jungle clearance, removal of silt in the canals entrusted to them along with water management as directed by the department Engineers
Failure of water management by the labours supplied by manpower agencies will be treated as breach of contract and liable for action

The lowest bidder (L-1) will be asked to produce the original document before awarding of the service. In case the lowest bidder fails to produce the original documents for entering in to an agreement or the Original documents submitted does not match with the uploaded documents or found false, then his bid is treated as non-responsive bid as per clause-26(4) of the KTPP rules. The name of lowest bidder who does not produce the original documents would be removed from the select list of Labour Department registration and barred from the participation in any of the tenders invited by the KNNL there after apart from forfeiting the EMD paid through e-cash

The tenderer is requested to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance well before the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The Nigam KNNL or department shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches or any other issues

The necessary certificates/documents in support of eligibility criteria fulfilled as stipulated shall be scanned and attached to their e-tender documents. The Original certificates/documents shall be produced if necessitates
If any of the dates mentioned above happens to be a general holiday, the next working day is valid
Further information can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer, KNNL No.6 Canal Division Ballari during office hours

Conditional tenders shall be rejected and EMD shall be forfeited The Officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons whatsoever
Corrigendum will be published in the web site only for all modifications/corrections if any
The contractor should mention their recent correct postal address and e-mail address in the declaration form
Department has no binding/obligation for providing quarters or any civic amenities for the accommodation of workers provided by the agency

The payment of bills is dependent on the availability of funds in the department/Nigam. However non payment of regular monthly bills should not be a reason for stoppage of rendering man power services and payment to the labours
The rates paid to the persons engaged by the Man Power Agency (for various categories of work) should not be less than Minimum Wages as declared from the Labour Department of Government of Karnataka
The tender processing charges paid by the bidders are non-refundable, even if the tenders are cancelled
Incomplete tenders will be summarily rejected
The evaluation will only be done based on the information provided by the contractor as Uploaded in the e-portal
Typo-graphical errors (if any) will not be the ground for any claims by the Contractor
Tendering by Joint Venture are not Allowed

In case of delay in the payment of bills by the Nigam the payment should be made by the agency on their own with in 7th of every month to their employees. Reasons for delay in the payment of salary of employees should not be thrust /attributed to the Nigam
The agency shall regularly remit the EPF, other relevant Taxes and Cess to the government as per Rules

Agency shall provide proof of having remitted EPF/Taxes/ Cess / ESI to the Government of monthly payment through nationalized bank to the employees within 10th of every month with the bill, failing which this office will withhold further payment to the agency. If the agency fails to remit the EPF/Taxes/Cess /ESi to the Government within the stipulated period. The name will berecommended for the Labour Department for taking further action and be disqualified from participating in the KNNL work
Rates tendered are inclusive of BASIC PLUS DA PLUS EPF AND ESI PLUS SERVICE CHARGE and exclusive of GST. BASIC AND DA are as per Labour Department labour rates.

For any disputes/ problems with the Man Power Services supplied in accordance with Labour Law, the department bears no responsibility what soever. The agency will solely be responsible for the same. The penalties if levied by the labour department/to be born by the agency only

Considering the availability of funds, the bill of the agency will be paid. But before this, the tenderer should take care to supply adequate water to the notified crops. With proper water management and upon ascertaining the same, the bills of the tenderer shall be paid

The Employer reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantum of Man Power Services with in the contract period and agency shall have no claim of any nature what so ever. The agency shall pay the salary and allowances to the Man Power staff category wise, not lessthan the Minimum Wages as declared from the Labour Department of Government of Karnataka. The agency shall agree to indemnify the department to compensate to department incase of any loss or damage occurred involving department equipments/ assets due to negligence of Man Power staff so deployed.

During the period of contract, tendered shall abide at all times, all existing Labour Enactments, rates of wages and Rules made their under, regulations, notifications and Bye Laws of State government, Central Government and Local Authority

The Successful tenderer should give the details of name of all outsourcing manpower daily duty chart for various sections in which they are employed and everyday attendanceshould be taken jointly from the agency & departmental officials / Engineers.If the worker fails to work as assigned, the agency has to take action and replace immediately

In case of any employee abstaining from the work, either on long leave or under any other circumstances shall be removed from the site by the department for his misconduct, the agency should immediately provide suitable substitute, so that work does not got hampered
The Employer can terminate the contract at any point of time without assigning any reason what so ever without any prior notice

Muster Roll of its/ his employee shall be maintained by the agency/firm and payment will strictly be made based on the number of personnel who have attended work in any given monthas per indent of the Engineer In Charge. The details of wages paid to the workers are to be submitted to the nigam before 7th of every month
The agencies shall supply the manpower labour/staff who possess the prior experience of water management in major and medium irrigation system of the government
The rate considered in bill of quantities are inclusive of EPF, ESI, and service charges, GST will be paid wherever it is applicable

The agency shall supply man power who have experience in water management/ watch and ward / sanitation, water supply works / Electrician/ Experience drivers with license holder and should be in Tungabhadra Command Area

If two or more bidders quoted same lowest price to the work, the award of work will be done by lottery system or by obtaining no objection certificate in this regard, by forthcoming bidders who have quoted the same price and the date for which will be intimated
Before Participation in the Tender, bidder should visit the worksite to know the nature of work.

The agency has to make the Retrospective payment of manpower supplied for maintenance of camp and office(Civic & Watchman) and sowdies as decided by the KNNL. The The penalties/additional payments necessary as per prevailing labour norms w.r.t retrospective payment are to be born by the agency without claiming any additional fund by the nigama

The Agency has to upload the Undertaking letter regarding making wages/payments to his workers within 10th of every month and also remittance of workers EPF & ESI to concerneddepartment with in the stipulated period as per rules/norms and should also agree for submission of EPF,ESI Challan copies with bills and agency has to submit the above said undertaking letter in bond paper at the time of executing Agreement and EMD of the successful bidders will be refunded only after the conclusion of tenders and Security Deposit will be returned after the completion of work
EMD of the unsuccessful bidders will be refunded only after the acceptance of tenders by the Competent Authority
The laws of the labour department are to be strictly fallowed. The necessary details as prescribedby the labour department are to be submitted to the concerned within the stipulated period

Within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Executive Engineer, a Security deposit in any of the forms given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with Clause 25.5 of ITT and Clause 44 of the Conditions of Contract
The Agreement will be finalized by including EPF & ESI at the time of Evaluation/ Contract Execution
Agency has to pay the EPF & ESI as per privileging rates

As per Ministry Of Finance Department of Expenditure procurement policy dtd: 06-01-2023 the minimum Service charges in the Eproc of Man Power Outsourcing service may be fixed as 3.85 %amount Which is included in Amount put to tender. The directions of the above GO will be followed

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder/firm/company should have satisfactorily completed (not less than 90 percent of contract value) and one similar Labour oriented Man Power of value not less than 50percentage of the amount put to tender during the last five years Rs. 27.93Lakhs from 2021-22 to 2025-26. The work done certificate should be obtained duly signed from an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned division should be uploaded.(Additional weightage at 10percentage for each year will be added to the cost of work done in previous years to bring it to the present price level 2026-27).
The intending bidder should furnish the Registration Certificate of labour licence issued by the Labour Department with requisite validity

Bid Capacity -Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under - Assessed available tender capacity- AxNx2.5-B
Income Tax Returns filed for the Financial Year 2024-25 (Assessment year 2025-26)

The bidder should have an average annual financial turnover same as the amount put to tender i.e Rs.55.86 lakhs in any two financial years during the last five years. From 2021-22 to 2025-26. Certificate issued by the Chartered Accountant clearly mentioning the UDIN No should be enclosed. The Certificate without UDIN No are liable for rejection. (Additional weightage at 10% for each year shall be given for turn over to bring it to the present price level 2026-27).
